2607.12650.title: Evidence-Grounded Verified Agentic Reasoning: A Path Toward Eliminating LLM Hallucination in Empirical Inference via Tool-Attested Kernel Proofs
2607.12650.paper_summary: Tool access alone does not make LLM empirical reasoning governable: accepted outputs need not descend from attested evidence, and accepted deductions need not hold up under formal scrutiny. We present EG-VAR (Evidence-Grounded Verified Agentic Reasoning), a Lean 4-based tool-calling architecture in which the Lean kernel is the sole minter of Verified claims via tool-attestation axioms and declared source lifts. Every verified output structurally descends from an attested tool call (Thm. 3.1) and a kernel-checked chain of valid inference (Thm. 3.2); residual outputs are honest Abstain with a replayable audit trail. On a subcollection of TableBench numerical reasoning (n=120), EG-VAR attains 120/120 versus a 95% same-tool baseline; on counterfactual stress tests (5 domains x 2 models), EG-VAR stays 100% source-faithful while same-tool drops to 80-90% (no-tool 50-80%). With the LLM as deployment-time formalizer, residual semantic-formalization error is 3.3% on Sonnet and 1.7% on Opus. We position EG-VAR as a technical-governance interface for high-stakes empirical claims: a formal sidecar makes the target proposition, source scope, evidence boundary, proof obligation, and abstention condition auditable, eliminating unsupported Verified outputs today while turning formalization errors, lift and source-authority disputes, ambiguities, and abstentions into explicit audit targets. Over time, typed sidecars in datasets, APIs, public records, and AI-generated documents can amortize this formalization burden into reusable infrastructure.
2607.12650.paper_summary_zh: 工具訪問本身並不使 LLM 的經驗推理可控：接受的輸出不必源自經過證實的證據，接受的推論也不必在正式審查下成立。 我們提出了 EG-VAR（基於證據的驗證代理推理），這是一種基於 Lean 4 的工具調用架構，其中 Lean 核心是通過工具證明公理和聲明的來源提升來唯一鑄造驗證聲明的實體。 每個經過驗證的輸出結構上源自一個經過證實的工具調用（定理 3.1）和一個核心檢查的有效推理鏈（定理 3.2）；剩餘輸出是誠實的放棄，並具有可重播的審計痕跡。 在 TableBench 數字推理的子集合上（n=120），EG-VAR 在 120/120 的表現上超過了 95% 的同工具基準；在反事實壓力測試中（5 個領域 x 2 個模型），EG-VAR 保持 100% 的來源忠實，而同工具下降到 80-90%（無工具為 50-80%）。 在 LLM 作為部署時的形式化工具下，剩餘的語義-形式化錯誤在 Sonnet 上為 3.3%，在 Opus 上為 1.7%。 我們將 EG-VAR 定位為高風險經驗聲明的技術治理介面：一個正式的副駕駛使目標命題、來源範圍、證據邊界、證明義務和放棄條件可審計，消除當前不支持的驗證輸出，同時將形式化錯誤、提升和來源權威爭議、模糊性和放棄轉變為明確的審計目標。 隨著時間的推移，數據集、API、公共記錄和 AI 生成的文檔中的類型副駕駛可以將這一形式化負擔攤銷為可重用的基礎設施。
